data.mainMessage:
Happy Birthday to my absolute favorite person, [HER_NAME]! 🌻💛

From the moment you came into my life, everything became so much brighter and warmer. You have this incredible way of making ordinary days feel like pure magic. Today is all about celebrating you—your radiant smile, your gentle heart, and all the little things that make you so uniquely wonderful.

I hope this little world I made for you brings a huge smile to your face, just like you bring to mine every single day. No matter where life takes us, you will always be my favorite adventure and my safest home.

Thank you for being you, and for being mine. Let’s make this year your best one yet.

With all my love,

[MY_NAME]

For all the times you made me angry

secrets.message: A heart was hiding something, just waiting for you to find it.
It said do not open. You opened it anyway. That is exactly why I like you.
Even clouds have secrets. This one is: you are easy to be happy around.
Make a wish. I already made one for you.
Sunflowers turn toward the light. So do I, when you walk in.
I only look small. I carry a lot of secrets.
You stayed until the end. Thank you for that.
